item_name: Rothco Carbon Steel Half Face Mask
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Carbon Steel Half Face Mask provides dependable protection for your lower face while maintaining comfort and breathability. Made from lightweight carbon steel, this durable mask shields your mouth and nose from debris, making it ideal for airsoft or similar activities. The ergonomic design ensures a comfortable fit, while the mesh caging allows airflow and clear communication without muffling your voice. Adjustable elastic straps provide a secure, customizable fit, accommodating most head sizes.
